# A variable set to nothing is not an override. A shell exports empty strings
# for variables nobody set, and a location that took them would silently
# unconfigure every machine that has one.
user {"store":"A"}
# setup 1: ok
env store empty
# setup 2: ok
load
# expect 3: ok store=A/user [CFG-W3]
key store
# expect 4: ok value=A from=user [CFG-W3]
